evidence.reason: The finding is anchored at the one-line `blocked(config...)` blackout check that sat after the source-snapshot and review-diff scans, and it asks that provider admission be rechecked at the final launch boundary rather than relying on a check made before the (potentially slow) payload scans. Commit 3f8467d1 rewrites exactly these lines: it re-samples the shared dispatch deadline at the last boundary before any driver call, sets the driver's wall-clock budget to the actual remaining time, refuses to start when the scans consumed the margin, and feeds that remaining time into the `blocked` blackout check so preparation that overran defers instead of reaching the window. The stale-admission-after-scanning gap the finding describes is thereby closed at this final boundary; the earlier blackout-only switch is no longer present in that form.
